pipeline.license_origin: Internal (worldwide rights); Roche collaboration for HCC trial supply

indications.trial_name: Pivotal Phase 3 amezalpat + atezo + bev vs atezo + bev
indications.trial_design: Randomized, OS primary endpoint, pre-specified early efficacy analysis

indications.trial_status: Ongoing in China (Novatim-sponsored); IND planned for FDA in 2026, registrational Phase 2b in China by end-2026
